records.prompt: Independent blind summary reader. Read ONLY /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/nemesis/2026-11-04-batch-231507/source-continuation-2026-11-05-01/full-iteration-12/summary-snapshot.md and questions.json in that same directory. No other files, sources, key, manifests, prior outputs, parent history, links, browsing, prior game knowledge or contact with other readers/reviewers. Parent contact is limited to file/processing status; do not seek or receive rule, grade or finding feedback. Read the COMPLETE inputs in chunks if output truncates. Across preplanned batches, answer the entire125-question bank from the summary. In THIS turn, answer only the first up-to10 question objects in original array order; save those substantive answers before stopping. Later preplanned continuations will cover the remaining questions in this same context. Treat each question as an independent scenario unless it explicitly says otherwise; use only that question's own stated premises. Check numerical inferences against its listed inputs and the supporting rule, and reconcile the final ruling with the calculation. For EACH question in this batch, first enumerate its requested clauses in a requested_parts array, using one entry per independently requested clause rather than copying the whole question. Then give an answer string with separate numbered rulings aligned with those entries. Include requested quantities, destinations, visibility, timing, exceptions and reasons; do not replace an asked procedure with just its name. Before saving, compare every requested clause with that question's answer and fill omitted facts the summary supports. A citation does not substitute for an answer. In the evidence field include the complete supporting operative sentence(s) needed for each literal requested clause, preserving relevant conditions, exceptions and outcomes. Do not shorten away an operative part of the rule or substitute an ellipsed fragment or topic label. For a derived outcome, quote its complete supporting rule unit and explicitly state the inference. Quote accurately; never fabricate an explicit quotation or present an inference as one. Keep evidence as a string, associating quotations with the corresponding requested-part numbers. Before saving, check each affirmative ruling, quantity and inference against its cited rule and resolve any internal contradiction. Include the requested facts and necessary reasons without adding unrelated rulings. No brevity requirement; use multiple tool writes if needed to keep full details. If summary lacks or expressly leaves a fact unresolved, say so; never guess. Each object: id, requested_parts, answer, support(supported/partial/unsupported), evidence(complete supporting rule quotations and any stated inference). Stop after this batch is saved. Save valid JSON {reader,inputs_read,answers:[...]} containing only the answered prefix, with no unanswered placeholder entries, to /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/nemesis/2026-11-04-batch-231507/source-continuation-2026-11-05-01/full-iteration-12/reader-a-draft.json.
